title: Glassworks
scene: New York minimalism (Philip Glass Ensemble, CBS Masterworks)
notes: Six short studio pieces: arpeggiated piano, winds and synth loops, minimalism for headphones.

title: Music in Twelve Parts
notes: Four-hour loud compendium of additive and cyclic repetition for amplified ensemble.

title: Einstein on the Beach
scene: New York minimalism (Philip Glass Ensemble, with Robert Wilson)
notes: Plotless four-act opera: counted numbers, solfège, organs, solo violin, Wilson's images.

title: Koyaanisqatsi
scene: New York minimalism (Philip Glass Ensemble, film score)
notes: Propulsive organ, brass and voices for Reggio's wordless time-lapse film.
